Name: Simple Pet Again
Author: Xsyy
Description:
Simple Pet Again

Give your pets a little extra affection! Pet them again throughout the day with a short [b]3-second cooldown per pet[/b].

The first daily pet gives normal friendship and rewards. Extra pets show the heart reaction and play your pet’s usual sound, without granting additional friendship or gifts.

Use the normal interaction button. 

[b]Requirements:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ and SMAPI 4.0+.

[b]Installation:[/b] Extract the
[code]SimplePetAgain[/code]folder into your
[code]Mods[/code]folder and launch through SMAPI.
